nitroxanalyser.changelog: Shows the complete setup Wi-Fi SSID and password on the Nitrox display by wrapping values onto additional rows instead of truncating them.

divesoftadapter.changelog: Connects saved Wi-Fi immediately at startup, uses setup Wi-Fi only as a bounded fallback, fixes the green-LED and setup-AP transition after saving Wi-Fi, and improves settings responsiveness and hostname handling.
